pages.text: While traveling the world, you might stumble upon a mysterious lonely tower. It is home to a peculiar Wizard studying the magical properties of aquatic creatures.
He will offer you a deal: for a small fee, the Wizard can enchant your caught fish, increasing its market value or adding useful effects.

$(l)But be warned!$()$(br)$(br)This mage is self-taught, and his spells are highly unstable. Over time, the enchantments he casts may simply dissipate, returning the fish to normal. Sell it before the magic wears off!
